questions.text: रितिका एक नई कपड़े धोने की मशीन खरीदना चाहती थी। वह 'इलैक दुनिया' गई, जो एक बड़ा इलेक्ट्रॉनिक स्टोर है। उसने वहाँ प्रदर्शित विभिन्न ब्राण्ड्स और मॉडल जैसे केएम, नीओ, यूनीपूल, आईएनएच आदि देखे। स्टोर पर विक्रयकर्त्ता ने कपड़े धोने की विभिन्न मशीनों की गुणवत्ता, ब्राण्ड प्रतिष्ठा तथा मूल्यों के अंतर को समझाया। अब रितिका कपड़े धोने की पूर्ण-स्वचालित, अर्ध-स्वचालित, टॉप लोड तथा फ्रंट लोड मशीनों की तुलना कर सकती थी। विक्रयकर्त्ता ने उसे प्रोत्साहित किया कि वह अपना समय ले, विभिन्न ब्राण्ड्स की जाँच करे और अपने प्रश्नों का समाधान करे। रितिका पास की एक अन्य दुकान पर भी गई ताकि कपड़े धोने की विभिन्न मशीनों के मूल्यों एवं विशेषताओं की तुलना कर सके। सभी उपलब्ध विकल्पों की तुलना करने के बाद, रितिका ने कपड़े धोने की 'नीओ' फ्रन्ट लोड मशीन को चुना क्योंकि उसके बजट में यह सर्वश्रेष्ठ विशेषताएँ प्रस्तावित कर रही थी। उपरोक्त स्थिति में रितिका द्वारा उपयोग में लाया गया अधिकार है:
questions.text_english: Ritika wanted to buy a new washing machine. She visited 'Elec Duniya', a large electronics store. She saw there many different brands and models on display like KM, Neo, Unipool, INH etc. The salesperson at the store explained the differences in quality, brand reputation and prices of different washing machines. Ritika could now compare fully automatic, semi-automatic, top load and front load washing machines. The salesperson encouraged her to take her time, check different brands and resolve her queries. Ritika also went to another shop nearby to compare prices and features of different washing machines. After comparing all the available options, Ritika chose a 'Neo' front load washing machine because it offered the best features within her budget. The consumer right exercised by Ritika in the above case is:

options.D: क्षतिपूर्ति का अधिकार

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Right to consumer education. Ritika exercised the Right to Consumer Education because she actively gathered information about different brands, models, features and prices before making a purchase decision. She visited multiple shops, compared options and made an informed choice. This right empowers consumers to acquire the knowledge needed to be well-informed buyers. Option (A) Right to be heard applies when a complaint is filed; (B) Right to be assured relates to safety from hazardous goods; (D) Right to seek redressal applies when compensation is sought for a defective product.

questions.text: अल्फा निर्माणी कम्पनी के कर्मचारी धातु के कलपुर्जों का निर्माण करने के लिए परम्परागत विधियों का उपयोग कर रहे थे। चूँकि कोई मानक कार्यविधि विद्यमान नहीं थी, अतः कर्मचारी अपने व्यक्तिगत अनुभव एवं अनुमान पर भरोसा करते थे। परिणामस्वरूप असेम्बली लाइन में उत्पादकता में कमी आनी प्रारंभ हो गई। उत्पादकता में सुधार के लिए कम्पनी ने वैज्ञानिक प्रबन्ध में विशेषज्ञता प्राप्त एक सलाहकार नियुक्त किया। सलाहकार ने समझाया कि कार्यक्षमता को अधिकतम करने की केवल एक सर्वश्रेष्ठ विधि थी तथा इस विधि को उचित अध्ययन एवं विश्लेषण के माध्यम से विकसित किया जा सकता है। उसने इस बात पर बल दिया कि वैज्ञानिक विधि को कर्मचारियों द्वारा उपयोग में लाई जा रही पुरानी पद्धति के स्थान पर परिवर्तित कर देना चाहिए। अतः वैज्ञानिक विधि को विकसित करने के लिए सलाहकार ने कार्य-अध्ययन के माध्यम से ध्यानपूर्वक परम्परागत विधियों की जाँच पड़ताल की और सर्वश्रेष्ठ तरीकों का एकीकरण कर एक मानक विधि विकसित की जिसे संगठन में प्रत्येक व्यक्ति द्वारा अपनाया जायेगा। वैज्ञानिक विधि का उपयोग करने के बाद छः महीने में ही उत्पादकता तीन गुना बढ़ गई। वैज्ञानिक प्रबन्ध का वह सिद्धान्त, जिसने कम्पनी की उत्पादकता को बढ़ाने में सहायता की, था:
questions.text_english: The workers in Alpha manufacturing company were using traditional methods for production of metal parts. Since no standard procedure existed, workers relied on personal experience and guess work. As a result, productivity in the assembly line began to decline. To improve productivity, the company hired a consultant specializing in scientific management. The consultant explained that there was only one best method to maximize efficiency and this method could be developed through proper study and analysis. He emphasized that the scientific method should replace the old method, that the workers were using. So, to develop the scientific method, the consultant carefully investigated the traditional methods through work-study and by unifying the best practices, he developed a standard method that would be followed by everyone in the organization. After applying scientific method, there was a three fold increase in productivity within six months. The principle of scientific management which helped the company in increasing the productivity was:

options.A: विज्ञान पद्धति, न कि अँगूठा टेक नियम
options.D: प्रत्येक व्यक्ति का उसकी अधिकाधिक क्षमता एवं समृद्धि के लिए विकास

options_english.D: Development of Each and Every Person to His or Her Greatest Efficiency and Prosperity

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Science, not Rule of Thumb. The consultant replaced the old, unscientific approach of relying on personal experience and guesswork with a scientifically developed standard method through proper work-study and analysis. This is precisely the principle of 'Science, not Rule of Thumb' propounded by F.W. Taylor, which insists that every task must be based on scientific investigation rather than personal judgment. Option (B) relates to goodwill between management and workers; (C) relates to team spirit over individual interests; (D) relates to training workers to their maximum potential.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए:
कथन – I: उपभोक्ताओं को अपने हितों के संरक्षण एवं संवर्धन के लिए इकट्ठे होकर उपभोक्ता संगठन के रूप में संगठित हो जाना चाहिए।
कथन – II: उपभोक्ता संरक्षण अधिनियम में उपभोक्ताओं की शिकायतों के निवारण के लिए द्वि-स्तरीय प्रवर्तन तंत्र की स्थापना का प्रावधान है।
दिए गए कथनों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement – I: Consumers should get together and form themselves into consumer associations for protection and promotion of their interests.
Statement – II: The Consumer Protection Act provides for setting up a two-tier enforcement machinery for the redressal of consumer grievances.
With reference to given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.C: कथन I सत्य है, कथन II असत्य है।
options.D: कथन I असत्य है, कथन II सत्य है।

options_english.C: Statement I is true, Statement II is false.
options_english.D: Statement I is false, Statement II is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Statement I is true, Statement II is false. Statement I is correct because consumers are encouraged to form associations to protect and promote their collective interests. Statement II is false because the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 actually provides for a three-tier quasi-judicial machinery — the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, the State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, and the National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission — not a two-tier machinery. Hence only Statement I is true.

questions.text:
उपरोक्त चित्र से सम्प्रेषण प्रक्रिया के तत्त्व को पहचानिए:
(दृष्टिबाधित विद्यार्थियों के लिए: सम्प्रेषण प्रक्रिया का वह तत्त्व जो संदेश को सम्प्रेषण संकेतों में परिवर्तित करता है:)
questions.text_english:
Identify the element of communication process from the above picture:
(For Visually Impaired Candidates: The element of communication process that converts the message into communication symbols is:)

options.D: डिकोडिंग

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Noise (शोर). The picture shows a sender speaking through a megaphone with garbled symbols (!*+%x) reaching the receiver who appears confused. This depicts Noise — any barrier or distortion that interferes with the accurate transmission and understanding of a message in the communication process. Option (A) Feedback is the receiver's response back to the sender; (B) Media is the channel used; (D) Decoding is when the receiver interprets the symbols. For visually impaired candidates, the answer to the alternative question is (D) Encoding — it is the process of converting the message into communication symbols.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए – अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R):
अभिकथन (A): बहुत सी जागरूक व्यावसायिक फर्मों ने अपने स्वयं के शिकायत एवं उपभोक्ता सेवा कक्ष की स्थापना कर ली है।
कारण (R): उपभोक्ता यदि किसी वस्तु या सेवा से संतुष्ट नहीं है तो उसे शिकायत दर्ज कराने तथा उसकी सुनवाई का अधिकार है।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements – Assertion (A) and Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Many enlightened business firms have set up their own consumer service and grievance cells.
Reason (R): The consumer has a right to file a complaint and to be heard in case of dissatisfaction with a good or service.
Choose the correct alternative from the alternatives given below:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों असत्य हैं।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है तथा कारण (R) सत्य है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are false.
options_english.B: Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is true.
options_english.C: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.D: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A). Many enlightened business firms have indeed set up their own grievance cells — this is the Assertion. The reason behind this is that consumers have a legal right to be heard when they are dissatisfied with a product or service. Because this right exists, businesses proactively establish grievance cells to address consumer complaints and avoid formal legal proceedings. Thus, Reason (R) directly explains why Assertion (A) is true.

questions.text: सुधा, एक कॉर्पोरेट अधिकारी है और उसे कल अपने कार्यालय में होने वाले एक अभिनंदन समारोह में भाग लेना है। अतः उसने अपने बाल रंगने का निर्णय लिया। अपने मित्र के सुझाव पर उसने बालों को रंगने का 'नटूरो' रंग खरीदा। डिब्बे पर दिए गए आवश्यक विवरणों जैसे शेड, इसके घटक, प्रयोग करने के निर्देश, समाप्ति तिथि को पढ़ने के बाद सुधा ने डिब्बे को खोला। उसने डिब्बे में से रंगने वाली ट्यूब और डेवलपर की बोतल निकाली और डिब्बे को फेंक दिया। सुधा द्वारा फेंके गए डिब्बे की पैकेजिंग का स्तर था:
questions.text_english: Sudha is a corporate executive and has to attend a felicitation function to be held in her office tomorrow. So she decides to colour her hair. On recommendation of her friend, she purchased 'NATURO' hair colour. After reading essential details such as shade, its ingredients, usage instructions and expiry date mentioned on the box, Sudha opened the box. She took out the colour tube and developer bottle from the box and threw away the box. The level of packaging of box thrown away by Sudha was:

options.D: साधारण पैकेजिंग

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Secondary packaging. The box that Sudha threw away is secondary packaging. Secondary packaging is the outer packaging that holds the primary packages together — in this case, the box contained the primary packages which were the colour tube and the developer bottle. Primary packaging directly contains the product (the tube and bottle are primary packaging). Transportation packaging is used for bulk movement of goods. Since the box was the outer covering holding the primary packages and was discarded after opening, it is secondary packaging.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए – अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R):
अभिकथन (A): पूँजी बाज़ार प्रतिभूतियों की तुलना में मुद्रा बाज़ार के प्रपत्रों में अधिक तरलता होती है।
कारण (R): मुद्रा बाज़ार प्रपत्रों का व्यापार स्टॉक एक्सचेंज में किया जाता है।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्पों का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements – Assertion (A) and Reason (R):
Assertion (A): Money market instruments have a higher degree of liquidity as compared to capital market securities.
Reason (R): Money market instruments are traded on the stock exchanges.
Choose the correct alternative from the alternatives given below:

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, लेकिन कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है तथा कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है तथा कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true and Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Assertion (A) is true and Reason (R) is false. The Assertion is correct — money market instruments such as Treasury Bills, Commercial Paper and Certificates of Deposit are highly liquid because they are short-term instruments that can be quickly converted to cash. However, the Reason is false — money market instruments are NOT traded on stock exchanges. They are traded over-the-counter (OTC) or through the Reserve Bank of India and other financial institutions. Stock exchanges deal primarily in capital market securities like shares and long-term debentures.

questions.text: रवि ने एक सुप्रसिद्ध ज्वेलरी की दुकान से सोने की ज्वेलरी खरीदी। उसने यह सुनिश्चित किया कि ज्वेलरी पर हॉलमार्क था जो इसकी शुद्धता तथा प्रामाणिकता की पुष्टि करता था। वस्तु एवं सेवा कर के भुगतान से बचने के लिए उसने विक्रयकर्त्ता से सोने का भार तथा उसे बनाने के शुल्क को एक कागज़ के टुकड़े पर लिखकर देने को कहा। ज्वेलरी को खरीदते समय रवि द्वारा निम्नलिखित में से उपभोक्ता के किस उत्तरदायित्व को पूरा नहीं किया गया?
questions.text_english: Ravi purchased gold jewellery from a reputed jewellery store. He ensured that the jewellery had a hallmark which confirm its purity and authenticity. To avoid paying goods and services tax (GST) he asked the salesperson to write the gold weight and making charges on a slip of paper and hand over it to him. Which of the following responsibilities of a consumer was not fulfilled by Ravi while purchasing jewellery?

options.A: बाज़ार में उपलब्ध विभिन्न वस्तुओं एवं सेवाओं के सम्बन्ध में जानकारी रखें जिससे बुद्धिमत्तापूर्ण चुनाव किया जा सके।
options.B: वस्तुओं एवं सेवाओं को खरीदने पर नकद रसीद माँगें।
options.C: केवल मानक वस्तुओं को ही खरीदें क्योंकि ये गुणवत्ता का विश्वास दिलाती हैं।
options.D: यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि आपके साथ सही व्यवहार हो अपनी दृढ़ता का परिचय दें।

options_english.A: Be aware about various goods and services available in the market so that an intelligent and wise choice can be made.
options_english.B: Ask for a cash memo on purchase of goods and services.
options_english.C: Buy only standardized goods as they provide quality assurance.
options_english.D: Assert yourself to ensure that you get a fair deal.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Ask for a cash memo on purchase of goods and services. Ravi failed to ask for a proper cash memo/receipt. Instead, he asked the salesperson to write the details on a mere slip of paper to avoid paying GST. A cash memo is an important document that serves as proof of purchase and helps in consumer protection. By not demanding a proper bill, Ravi not only failed his consumer responsibility but also abetted tax evasion. He did fulfil option (C) by buying hallmarked jewellery; option (A) by comparing; and option (D) by asserting himself to check for hallmark.

questions.text: कम्पनी के बढ़ते हुए परिचालनों के लिए 'कारो टैक सोल्यूशन्स' का उद्देश्य एक सॉफ्टवेयर तंत्र को विकसित करना था। ₹12,00,000 के बजट के साथ यह परियोजना छः महीने में पूरी की जानी थी। सॉफ्टवेयर विकसित करने वाले समूह ने परियोजना के एक भाग का बाह्य स्रोतीकरण करके, जिसके कारण ₹2,00,000 का अतिरिक्त खर्चा हुआ, परियोजना को सफलतापूर्वक समय पर पूरा कर दिया। निम्नलिखित में से पहचानिए कि क्या सॉफ्टवेयर विकसित करने वाला समूह:
questions.text_english: 'CARO Tech Solutions' aimed at development of a software system for the company's growing operations. The project was to be completed within six months with a budget of Rs. 12,00,000. The software development team successfully completed its project on time by outsourcing a part of the project, leading to an additional expense of Rs. 2,00,000. From the following, identify whether the software development team is:

options.D: न कुशल न ही प्रभावपूर्ण था।

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Effective but not efficient. The team was effective because it achieved its goal — completing the project on time. Effectiveness means achieving the desired result or goal. However, the team was not efficient because it exceeded the budget by Rs. 2,00,000 (from Rs. 12,00,000 to Rs. 14,00,000). Efficiency means achieving the goal with minimum possible cost and resource usage. Since the team used more resources than planned, it was effective but not efficient.

questions.text: अत्यधिक सर्दी एवं बढ़ते हुए प्रदूषण स्तर के कारण 'ग्रीन इंडिया इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स' ने एक नया पर्यावरण-हितैषी हीटर बाज़ार में उतारने की योजना बनाई। उसने सर्वेक्षण किया और पाया कि इस उत्पाद की माँग बहुत अधिक थी। चूँकि सर्दी का मौसम केवल 2 से 3 महीने का होता है, अतः मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी चाहता था कि आदेशों की समय पर आपूर्ति करने के लिए सभी प्रबन्धकों के मध्य आपसी समन्वय होना चाहिए। उच्च स्तरीय प्रबन्धकों को, यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि संगठन की नीतियों का उचित क्रियान्वयन हो, अपने अधीनस्थों के साथ समन्वय करने के लिए कहा गया। यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि हीटर समय पर तैयार हो जाएँ, उत्पादन प्रबंधक ने प्रचालन स्तर के प्रबन्धकों के साथ समन्वय किया। प्रचालन स्तर के प्रबन्धकों ने, यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि कार्य योजनाओं के अनुरूप आगे बढ़े, कर्मचारियों की गतिविधियों के साथ समन्वय किया। परिणामस्वरूप 'ग्रीन इंडिया इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स' समय पर अपने हीटर बाज़ार में उतारने में सफल हुई। उपरोक्त स्थिति में चर्चित समन्वय की विशेषता है:
questions.text_english: Due to severe winter and rising pollution levels, 'Green India Electronics' planned to launch a new eco-friendly heater in the market. It conducted a survey and found that the demand of this product was very high. As the winter season lasts only for 2 to 3 months, the Chief Executive Officer wanted that there should be close coordination among all the managers to deliver orders on time. Top level managers were asked to work in coordination with their subordinates to ensure that company's policies were properly followed. To ensure that the heaters would be ready on time, the production manager co-ordinated with the operational level managers. Operational level managers co-ordinated the activities of the workers to ensure that work proceeded according to plans. As a result 'Green India Electronics' was able to launch its heaters on time, in the market. The feature of co-ordination discussed in the above case is:

options.A: समन्वय एक सोचा समझा कार्य है।
options.B: समन्वय सभी प्रबन्धकों का उत्तरदायित्व है।
options.C: समन्वय एक निरन्तर चलने वाली प्रक्रिया है।
options.D: समन्वय कार्यवाही में एकता लाता है।

options_english.B: Co-ordination is the responsibility of all managers.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Co-ordination is the responsibility of all managers. The case clearly shows that co-ordination was practised at all levels — the CEO coordinated with top-level managers, top-level managers coordinated with subordinates, the production manager coordinated with operational-level managers, and operational managers coordinated workers' activities. This demonstrates that co-ordination is not limited to any one level but is the responsibility of every manager throughout the organisation. Options (A), (C), and (D) are also features of coordination but are not specifically highlighted in this case.

questions.text: 'व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण निरन्तर बदलता रहता है चाहे वह तकनीकी सुधार के रूप में हो, उपभोक्ताओं की प्राथमिकताओं के रूप में हो या फिर बाज़ार में नए प्रतियोगियों के रूप में।' उपरोक्त कथन में व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण की जिस विशेषता पर प्रकाश डाला गया है, वह है:
questions.text_english: 'Business environment keeps on changing whether in terms of technological improvement, shifts in consumer preferences or entry of new competitors in the market.' The feature of business environment highlighted in the above statement is:

options.D: तुलनात्मकता

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Dynamic nature. The statement emphasises that the business environment continuously keeps changing — whether through technological advancements, changing consumer tastes, or the entry of new competitors. This ongoing change is the hallmark of the dynamic nature of business environment. Option (A) refers to the fact that all external forces collectively constitute the environment; (B) refers to the interrelation of forces making the environment hard to understand; (D) relativity means environment differs from organisation to organisation and country to country.

questions.text: वह स्थिति जब कोई कम्पनी अपने स्थायी वित्तीय प्रभारों, जैसे ब्याज का भुगतान, पूर्वाधिकारी अंशों पर लाभांश तथा देनदारियों, का पुनर्भुगतान नहीं कर पाती, जानी जाती __________ है।
questions.text_english: A position when a company is unable to meet its fixed financial charges like interest payment, dividend on preference shares and repayment obligations is referred to as ______ .

options.D: प्रचालन जोखिम

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Financial risk (वित्तीय जोखिम). Financial risk refers to the situation when a company is unable to meet its fixed financial obligations such as interest payments on debt, dividend on preference shares, and loan repayment obligations. It arises when a company uses excessive debt financing (financial leverage), which creates fixed charges that must be paid regardless of profitability. This is different from business risk, which arises from uncertainty in the operating environment.

questions.text: प्रबन्ध के नियोजन कार्य के महत्त्व के सम्बन्ध में निम्नलिखित में से गलत कथन को पहचानिए:
questions.text_english: Identify the incorrect statement with respect to the importance of planning function of management:

options.A: कार्य कैसे किया जाना है, इसका पहले से मार्गदर्शन कराकर, नियोजन निर्देशन की व्यवस्था करता है।
options.B: नियोजन, भविष्य को देखकर और परिवर्तनों का अनुमान लगाकर, अनिश्चितता को समाप्त करता है।
options.C: नियोजन, कार्यवाही के विभिन्न विकल्पों में से चयन कर, निर्णयन को सरल बनाता है।
options.D: नियोजन नवप्रवर्तन विचारों को प्रोत्साहित करता है क्योंकि नए विचार योजना का साकार रूप ले सकते हैं।

options_english.A: Planning provides directions by stating in advance how work is to be done.
options_english.B: Planning eliminates uncertainty by looking ahead and anticipating changes.
options_english.C: Planning facilitates decision making by making a choice among various alternative courses of action.
options_english.D: Planning promotes innovative ideas as new ideas can take the shape of concrete plans.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B), which is the incorrect statement. Planning does not eliminate uncertainty — it only reduces uncertainty. The future can never be predicted with complete accuracy and unforeseen changes will always occur. Planning helps managers anticipate changes and prepare for them, but it cannot eliminate uncertainty entirely. All other options are correct: (A) planning does provide directions; (C) planning does facilitate decision making; (D) planning does promote innovative ideas.

questions.text: संगठन वह प्रक्रिया है जो पहचाने गए एवं इच्छित परिणामों की प्राप्ति के लिए योजनाओं के कार्यान्वयन को कार्य के स्पष्टीकरण, कार्यशैली सम्बन्ध तथा संसाधनों को प्रभावपूर्ण ढंग से कार्य पर लगाकर, आरंभ करती है। इस प्रकार संगठन प्रक्रिया कुछ कदमों की श्रृंखला है जिन्हें इच्छित लक्ष्यों की प्राप्ति हेतु ध्यान में रखना आवश्यक है। संगठन प्रक्रिया के कदमों को सही क्रम में व्यवस्थित कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Organising is the process that initiates implementation of plans by clarifying jobs and working relationships and effectively deploying resources for attainment of identified and desired results. Organising process thus involves a series of steps that need to be taken in order to achieve the desired goal. Arrange the steps of the process of organizing in the correct order:

options.A: कार्य की पहचान तथा विभाजन, कार्य-निर्धारण, विभागीकरण, वृत्तांत सम्बन्ध स्थापन
options.B: कार्य की पहचान तथा विभाजन, कार्य-निर्धारण, वृत्तांत सम्बन्ध स्थापन, विभागीकरण
options.C: विभागीकरण, कार्य की पहचान तथा विभाजन, वृत्तांत सम्बन्ध स्थापन, कार्य-निर्धारण
options.D: कार्य की पहचान तथा विभाजन, विभागीकरण, कार्य-निर्धारण, वृत्तांत सम्बन्ध स्थापन

options_english.A: Identification and Division of work, Assignment of duties, Departmentalisation, Establishing authority and reporting relationships
options_english.B: Identification and Division of work, Assignment of duties, Establishing authority and reporting relationships, Departmentalisation
options_english.C: Departmentalisation, Identification and Division of work, Establishing authority and reporting relationships, Assignment of duties
options_english.D: Identification and Division of work, Departmentalisation, Assignment of duties, Establishing authority and reporting relationship

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D). The correct sequence of the organising process is: (1) Identification and Division of work — the total work is divided into specific jobs; (2) Departmentalisation — related jobs are grouped together into departments; (3) Assignment of duties — jobs are assigned to individuals best suited to perform them; (4) Establishing authority and reporting relationships — a hierarchy is created defining who reports to whom. This logical sequence ensures systematic implementation of plans.

questions.text: नियोजन की उस विशेषता को पहचानिए जो यह उल्लेख करती है कि नियोजन का उद्देश्य संगठन के सर्वश्रेष्ठ हित में भविष्य की घटनाओं का प्रभावी ढंग से सामना करना है:
questions.text_english: Identify the feature of planning which states that the purpose of planning is to meet future events effectively to the best advantage of an organisation:

options.A: नियोजन में निर्णय रचना निहित है।
options.D: नियोजन का केन्द्र-बिन्दु लक्ष्य प्राप्ति होता है।

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Planning is futuristic. This feature of planning states that the purpose of planning is to meet future events effectively to the best advantage of the organisation. Planning is always forward-looking — managers plan in the present for future activities. Through planning, organisations anticipate future opportunities and threats and prepare strategies accordingly. Option (A) refers to choosing among alternatives; (C) refers to the intellectual nature of planning; (D) refers to goal orientation.

questions.text: कॉलम-I में दिए गए प्रबन्ध के सिद्धान्त का कॉलम-II में दी गई उसकी व्याख्या से मिलान कीजिए:
questions.text_english: Match the principle of management given in Column – I with its explanation given in Column – II:
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D): (a) Discipline – (iii) obedience to organisational rules; (b) Unity of direction – (iv) each group of activities with same objective must have one head and one plan; (c) Order – (ii) a place for everything and everything in its place; (d) Unity of command – (i) every employee should have one and only one boss. Discipline requires adherence to rules; Unity of direction ensures all activities toward same goal are under one plan; Order ensures proper arrangement of resources; Unity of command prevents confusion from receiving orders from multiple superiors.

questions.text: नियन्त्रण प्रक्रिया का वह चरण जो वास्तविक निष्पादन एवं इच्छित परिणामों के विचलन को प्रकट करता है, वह है:
questions.text_english: The step of controlling process which reveals the deviation between actual performance and desired results is:

options.D: वास्तविक निष्पादन की मानकों से तुलना

options_english.D: Comparing actual performance with the standards

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Comparing actual performance with the standards. In the controlling process, after actual performance is measured, it is compared with the pre-set standards. It is this step that reveals the deviation — whether actual performance is above, below or equal to the standard. Option (A) is the first step where benchmarks are set; (B) is a subsequent step where the reasons for deviations are analysed; (C) is the final corrective step taken after analysis.

questions.text: 'कम्पनी अधिनियम के कुछ प्रावधान लाभांश के भुगतान पर प्रतिबंध लगाते हैं। लाभांश की घोषणा करते समय ऐसे प्रावधानों का पालन किया जाना चाहिए।' उपरोक्त में चर्चित लाभांश निर्णय को प्रभावित करने वाला कारक है:
questions.text_english: 'Certain provisions of the Companies Act place restrictions on payouts as dividend. Such provisions must be adhered to while declaring the dividend.' The factor affecting dividend decision discussed above is:

options.D: शेयर बाज़ार प्रतिक्रिया

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Legal constraints. The passage specifically mentions that provisions of the Companies Act restrict dividend payouts and must be complied with. This directly refers to legal constraints — legal requirements and provisions under statute that limit the amount or timing of dividend payment. Contractual constraints (B) arise from loan agreements with creditors; Access to capital market (A) relates to the company's ability to raise funds; Stock market reaction (D) concerns how share prices react to dividend announcements.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए:
कथन – I: नियन्त्रण को उन मुख्य परिणाम क्षेत्रों पर ही ध्यान केन्द्रित करना चाहिए जो संगठन की सफलता के लिए जटिल होते हैं।
कथन – II: केवल वही महत्त्वपूर्ण विचलन प्रबंध को सूचित किए जाने चाहिए जो अनुमति देने की सीमा से बाहर के हैं।
दिए गए कथनों के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए:
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully:
Statement – I: Control should focus on key result areas which are critical to the success of an organization.
Statement – II: Only significant deviations which go beyond the permissible limit should be brought to the notice of management.
With reference to the given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following:

options.C: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.D: कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है।

options_english.C: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.D: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Both the statements are true. Statement I is true — effective control focuses on Key Result Areas (KRAs), which are the critical areas that determine the success of an organisation. Managers cannot and need not control every activity. Statement II is also true — this is the principle of 'Management by Exception', which states that only significant deviations that exceed the permissible limits need to be reported to management so that time and effort are not wasted on trivial matters.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी सम्प्रेषण की संगठनात्मक बाधा नहीं है?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is NOT an organisational barrier to communication?

options.D: नियम एवं विनियम

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Organisational facilities. Organisational facilities such as meeting rooms, suggestion boxes, complaint boxes, and proper communication channels are facilitators of communication — they help communication happen effectively rather than blocking it. The organisational barriers to communication include Status (A) — difference in hierarchical positions can inhibit free flow of information; Lack of proper incentives (C) — when there is no reward for communicating, employees hesitate to send suggestions upward; Rules and regulations (D) — rigid rules can restrict the free flow of communication.

questions.text:
'रिया मार्ट' डिस्पोज़ेबल क्रॉकरी की एक निर्माणी कम्पनी है। वह पिछले पाँच वर्षों से इस व्यवसाय में है, लेकिन अच्छे लाभ अर्जित नहीं कर रही थी। इस बारे में चिंतित, मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी (CEO), वर्मा ने आन्तरिक अंकेक्षण के आदेश दिए। अंकेक्षण ने कई मुद्दे उजागर किए जैसे माल की चोरी, कर्मचारियों का देर से आना तथा उनके निष्पादन का ठीक न होना। माल की चोरी को रोकने के लिए, मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी, वर्मा ने स्टॉक की औचक जाँच आरम्भ की तथा स्टॉक की गतिविधियों पर नज़र रखने के लिए स्वचालित स्टॉक प्रबन्ध तंत्र स्थापित किया। एक बायोमेट्रिक उपस्थिति तंत्र की भी स्थापना की गई ताकि देर से आने वाले कर्मचारियों पर नज़र रखी जा सके। इसके अतिरिक्त, कर्मचारियों के निष्पादन में सुधार के लिए उन्हें पहले से ही बता दिया गया कि उनसे क्या कार्य करने की आशा की जाती है तथा उनके निष्पादन के क्या मानक हैं। इन कदमों के परिणामस्वरूप माल की चोरी कम हो गई, कर्मचारी अधिक समयनिष्ठ हो गए और उनके निष्पादन में सुधार हुआ।
(i) कम्पनी के मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी, वर्मा द्वारा निष्पादित प्रबन्ध के कार्य को पहचानिए एवं उसका उल्लेख कीजिए।
(ii) उपरोक्त (i) में पहचाने गए कार्य के महत्त्व के किन्हीं दो बिन्दुओं का उल्लेख कीजिए जिनकी चर्चा उपरोक्त अनुच्छेद में नहीं की गई।
questions.text_english:
'Riya Mart' is a company manufacturing disposable crockery. They have been in business for the past five years, but were not earning good profits. Concerned about this, the Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Verma, ordered an internal audit. The audit uncovered several issues like inventory pilferage, employees coming late and their performance not upto the mark. To stop inventory pilferage, Verma, the CEO, introduced surprise stock checks and installed an automated inventory management system to track stock movements. A biometric attendance system was also setup to keep a check on employees coming late. In addition to this, to motivate employees for better performance, they were told in advance what they are expected to do and what are their standards of performance. As a result of these steps, the inventory pilferage reduced, employees became more punctual and their performance improved.
(i) Identify and state the function of management performed by Verma, the Chief Executive Officer of the company.
(ii) State any two points of importance of the function identified in (i) above, which are not discussed in the above para.

sub_questions.text: कम्पनी के मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी, वर्मा द्वारा निष्पादित प्रबन्ध के कार्य को पहचानिए एवं उसका उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify and state the function of management performed by Verma, the Chief Executive Officer of the company.

key_points: Setting standards, measuring performance, comparing with standards, taking corrective action

sub_questions.solution: Verma performed the function of Controlling. Controlling is the process of measuring actual performance, comparing it with the planned standards, and taking corrective action to ensure that the organisational goals are achieved. Verma set performance standards for employees, introduced surprise stock checks to measure actual inventory, installed biometric attendance to track punctuality, and took corrective action by installing automated systems. All these steps are part of the controlling process.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त (i) में पहचाने गए कार्य के महत्त्व के किन्हीं दो बिन्दुओं का उल्लेख कीजिए जिनकी चर्चा उपरोक्त अनुच्छेद में नहीं की गई।
sub_questions.text_english: State any two points of importance of the function identified in (i) above, which are not discussed in the above para.

key_points: Controlling helps achieve efficient use of resources

sub_questions.solution: Two points of importance of Controlling not discussed in the passage are: First, Controlling makes planning effective — the control process ensures that planned activities are carried out and compares actual performance with plans, thereby making planning meaningful. Two importance points not mentioned in the passage

questions.solution: The function of management performed by Verma is Controlling. sub_questions.text_english: State any three measures to improve communication effectiveness.
sub_questions.solution: Three measures to improve communication effectiveness are: First, clarify ideas before communicating — the sender must thoroughly think through what message needs to be conveyed, to whom, and what the purpose is before communicating, so that the message is clear and complete. Second, use appropriate language and channel — the language should be simple and easily understood by the receiver, and the appropriate medium (written, verbal, electronic) should be chosen based on the nature of the message. Third, follow up on communication — the sender should seek feedback from the receiver to ensure the message has been correctly understood and acted upon, completing the communication loop.

sub_questions.text: नेतृत्व की किन्हीं तीन विशेषताओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any three features of leadership.
sub_questions.solution: Three features of leadership are: First, leadership involves influence — a leader influences the behaviour, attitudes and actions of others through personal qualities, authority or communication, guiding them towards desired goals. Second, leadership requires followers — there can be no leader without followers; a leader exists in relation to other people who are willing to be directed and motivated. Third, leadership is a continuous process — leadership is not a one-time act but an ongoing process of guiding, motivating and inspiring employees throughout the work situation to achieve organisational goals.

key_points: Any three measures to improve communication OR any three features of leadership

questions.solution:
Answer for part (a): Three measures to improve communication effectiveness are: (1) Clarify ideas before communicating — the sender must thoroughly plan and think through what needs to be communicated before sending the message, ensuring it is clear, complete and unambiguous. (2) Use appropriate language — the language used should be simple, familiar and suited to the receiver's understanding level so the message is not misinterpreted. (3) Ensure feedback — the communicator must seek feedback to confirm that the message has been understood as intended, thereby completing the communication cycle.

Answer for part (b): Three features of leadership are: (1) Leadership involves influence — a leader influences followers' behaviour and actions to achieve goals. (2) Leadership is goal-oriented — leadership exists to guide people toward specific organisational objectives. (3) Leadership is a continuous process — a leader must continuously motivate, guide and inspire followers throughout the work process.

sub_questions.text: मध्य-स्तरीय प्रबन्ध के किन्हीं तीन कार्यों का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any three functions of middle level management.
sub_questions.solution: Three functions of middle-level management are: First, interpreting and executing the policies of top management — middle-level managers translate the broad goals and policies set by top management into specific plans, programmes and instructions for the lower level. Second, coordinating activities across departments — they act as a bridge between top and lower management, ensuring smooth flow of communication and coordination among different departments. Third, training and developing lower management — middle-level managers guide, train and supervise the supervisory-level managers, helping them understand their roles, develop skills and achieve departmental targets efficiently.

sub_questions.text: विमुद्रीकरण की किन्हीं तीन विशेषताओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.solution: Three features of demonetisation are: First, it is a part of government economic policy — demonetisation is a monetary policy tool used by the government whereby existing legal tender currency is stripped of its status as legal tender, compelling people to exchange old notes for new ones. Second, it targets black money and corruption — a key aim of demonetisation is to unearth unaccounted money held in the form of cash, thereby reducing the shadow economy and tax evasion. Third, it promotes a digital and cashless economy — demonetisation encourages people to shift to digital payment methods like mobile wallets, net banking and card payments, reducing dependence on cash transactions.

key_points: Three functions of middle-level management OR three features of demonetisation

questions.solution:
Answer for part (a): Three functions of middle-level management are: (1) Interpreting policies — they interpret and explain the policies and plans of top management to the lower level supervisors and workers. (2) Coordinating activities — they coordinate the work of various departments and act as a communication link between top management and the operational level. (3) Training lower-level managers — they guide and train supervisory managers to improve their performance and develop capabilities.

Answer for part (b): Three features of demonetisation are: (1) Government policy measure — it is a deliberate government decision to render old high-value currency notes invalid. (2) Curbs black money — it forces holders of unaccounted cash to either deposit money (and face scrutiny) or lose its value, thus attacking the black economy. (3) Promotes digital payments — it accelerates the shift toward cashless transactions, improving financial inclusion and tax compliance.

'Sheetal Cosmetics Ltd.', is a fast growing beauty and skin care company known for its innovative products and aggressive market expansion. As the company increased its marketing activities like new product launches, accelerated advertising campaigns, social media promotions and influencer collaborations etc., the workload of the marketing department grew sharply. Despite working long hours, the marketing manager Arjun couldn't give adequate attention to strategic planning and high impact decisions as minor operational issues began consuming most of his time. Noticing this, the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) advised Arjun that it was now impractical for him to handle the entire volume of work alone, so he should allow his subordinates to take up routine tasks. This would not only help him manage his time better but also satisfy the subordinate's need for recognition. This will also provide opportunities to the subordinates to develop and exercise initiative.
(i) Identify the concept suggested by CEO that will help Arjun to manage volume of work effectively.
(ii) State any three points of importance of the concept identified in (i) above.

sub_questions.text_english: Identify the concept suggested by CEO that will help Arjun to manage volume of work effectively.
sub_questions.solution: The concept suggested by the CEO is Delegation of Authority. Delegation of authority is the process by which a manager assigns some of his work and authority to his subordinates, making them responsible for completing those tasks. The CEO advised Arjun to delegate routine operational tasks to his subordinates so that he could focus on strategic planning and high-impact decisions.

sub_questions.text: उपरोक्त (i) में पहचानी गई अवधारणा के महत्त्व के किन्हीं तीन बिन्दुओं का उल्लेख कीजिए।

Second, it motivates subordinates — when authority is delegated, subordinates feel trusted and recognised, which satisfies their psychological need for status and belonging, boosting their motivation and job satisfaction. Third, it develops managerial talent — delegation gives subordinates the opportunity to take decisions, handle responsibilities, and develop their skills and competencies, creating a pool of capable managers for the future of the organisation.

sub_questions.text_english: State any four merits of internal source of recruitment.
sub_questions.solution: Four merits of internal sources of recruitment are: First, it is economical — internal recruitment saves the cost and time involved in advertising, screening, interviewing and inducting new candidates from outside. Second, it motivates existing employees — when employees know that performance and loyalty can lead to promotion, they work harder and remain motivated, reducing turnover. Third, the candidate is familiar with the organisation — an existing employee already knows the company's culture, policies, procedures and work environment, reducing the time needed for induction and orientation. Fourth, it promotes a sense of security and loyalty — employees feel secure knowing they can grow within the organisation, which builds long-term loyalty and reduces absenteeism.

sub_questions.solution: Four benefits of training to employees are: First, improved performance — training equips employees with the latest knowledge and skills required to perform their jobs effectively and efficiently, resulting in higher-quality output and fewer errors. Second, better career prospects — employees who continuously upgrade their skills through training are better positioned for promotions and higher responsibilities, enhancing their career growth and progression within the organisation. Third, increased earnings — as employees become more skilled and productive through training, they can earn higher wages and are more likely to receive increments and bonuses. Fourth, higher job satisfaction and morale — trained employees feel confident and competent in performing their duties, which increases their job satisfaction, reduces anxiety, and boosts their overall morale and commitment to the organisation.

(4) Promotes security — employees feel secure about their future in the organisation, reducing turnover.

(2) Better career prospects — trained employees are more likely to be promoted. (3) Higher earnings — skill improvement leads to salary increments. questions.text_english:
(a) Explain the following points of importance of planning: (2+2)
(i) Planning establishes standards for controlling
(ii) Planning reduces overlapping and wasteful activities
OR
(b) Explain the following types of plans: (2+2)
(i) Objective
(ii) Method

sub_questions.text: नियोजन नियन्त्रण के मानकों का निर्धारण करता है।

key_points: Controlling becomes effective only with planned standards

sub_questions.solution: Planning establishes standards for controlling means that the goals, targets and standards set during the planning process serve as benchmarks against which actual performance is measured and compared. Controlling is effective only when there are clear pre-set standards to compare against. Without planning, there would be no standards, and controlling would have no basis. For example, if a company plans to sell 1,000 units per month, this becomes the standard. If actual sales are 800 units, the deviation of 200 units can be identified and corrective action taken. Thus planning and controlling are interrelated and mutually supportive functions.

sub_questions.text: नियोजन अतिव्याप्ति तथा अपव्ययी क्रियाओं को कम करता है।
sub_questions.text_english: Planning reduces overlapping and wasteful activities.
sub_questions.solution: Planning reduces overlapping and wasteful activities because well-made plans specify clearly which person or department is responsible for which activity, and how activities are to be sequenced and coordinated. When the work of different departments and individuals is properly planned and coordinated in advance, there is no duplication of effort or conflict over resources. Wasteful activities — those that do not contribute to achieving organisational goals — are identified and eliminated during the planning process, ensuring that all efforts and resources are purposefully directed. This results in efficient use of human, material and financial resources.

sub_questions.text: उद्देश्य

key_points: Objectives are ends towards which activities are directed

sub_questions.solution: Objectives are the ends or specific results that an organisation aims to achieve through its activities. They are the foundations of planning as they provide direction to all managerial and operational activities. Objectives must be specific, measurable, achievable, realistic and time-bound (SMART). For example, a company may have the objective of increasing sales by 20% in the current financial year. All plans — strategies, policies, programmes, budgets — are formulated to achieve these stated objectives. Objectives can be set at multiple levels: organisational, departmental and individual.

sub_questions.text: विधि

key_points: Method prescribes the way a task is to be performed
Part of single-use or standing plans

sub_questions.solution: A method is a plan that prescribes the specific manner or way in which a particular task or activity is to be performed. It describes the step-by-step procedure to be followed while doing a job. Methods are more specific than procedures and deal with a single activity at a time. For example, the method for handling a customer complaint may specify the exact steps — acknowledge the complaint, investigate, offer a solution within 24 hours, and follow up. Methods bring standardisation to work processes, reduce errors, save time and ensure consistency in output quality across the organisation.

key_points: Planning establishes standards for controlling AND Planning reduces overlapping, OR Objective AND Method explained

questions.solution:
Answer for part (a): (i) Planning establishes standards for controlling — the targets and goals set in the planning process become the benchmarks for measuring actual performance. Without plans, there would be no standards, and controlling would lose its purpose. For example, a sales target of Rs. 10 lakh becomes the standard; if actual sales are Rs. 8 lakh, the deviation can be addressed. (ii) Planning reduces overlapping and wasteful activities — through advance planning and coordination, duplication of efforts is avoided, resources are channeled purposefully, and non-contributory activities are eliminated.

Answer for part (b): (i) Objectives — these are the specific ends or results an organisation seeks to achieve, forming the basis of all planning activities. They must be SMART (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Realistic, Time-bound). (ii) Method — a method prescribes the specific step-by-step manner in which a task is to be performed, bringing standardisation and consistency to organisational activities.

questions.text: राजीव, 'टाको सोल्यूशन्स' एक सॉफ्टवेयर विकसित करने वाली कम्पनी तथा 'सबका मार्ट रिटेल' एक सुपर बाज़ार शृंखला, के निदेशक मंडल में था। वह दोनों कम्पनियों में प्रबन्ध के सिद्धान्तों का प्रयोग करना चाहता था ताकि कुशलता एवं लाभप्रदता में सुधार किया जा सके। वह जानता था कि प्रबन्ध के सिद्धान्तों को उसी प्रकार 'टाको सोल्यूशन्स' में प्रयोग किया जा सकता है जैसे 'सबका मार्ट रिटेल' में जबकि सिद्धान्तों को किस हद तक लागू किया जा सकता है, यह अलग-अलग होगा, क्योंकि एक सॉफ्टवेयर फर्म और सुपर बाज़ार शृंखला की कार्य-प्रकृति, प्रचालन-स्तर तथा व्यावसायिक गतिविधियाँ एक जैसी नहीं होतीं। राजीव यह भी जानता था कि प्रबन्ध के सिद्धान्त तैयार समाधान प्रदान नहीं करेंगे क्योंकि दोनों कम्पनियों द्वारा सामना की जाने वाली वास्तविक दुनिया की परिस्थितियाँ जटिल एवं परिवर्तनशील हैं। फिर भी, उसका विश्वास था कि छोटे से छोटा दिशानिर्देश भी बहुत-सी समस्याओं के समाधान में सहायता कर सकेगा और दोनों कम्पनियों के कार्य करने के तरीके में सुधार होगा। उपरोक्त स्थिति में उन दो बिन्दुओं को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए जो प्रबन्ध की प्रकृति पर प्रकाश डालते हैं।
questions.text_english: Rajiv was on the board of directors of 'Tako Solutions', a software development company and 'Sabka Mart Retail', a large supermarket chain. He wanted to apply management principles in both the companies to improve efficiency and profitability. He knew that management principles can be applied as much to 'Tako Solutions' as to 'Sabka Mart Retail' though the extent to which the principles can be applied will differ, because the nature of work, scale of operations and business activities in a software firm and a supermarket chain are not the same. Rajiv also knew that the management principles would not provide readymade solutions because real world situations faced by the two companies were very complex and dynamic. Still, he believed that even small guidelines could help in solving many problems and will improve the way both companies worked. Identify and explain the two points that highlight the nature of principles of management, in the above case.

key_points: Management principles are universal (applicable to all organisations)
Management principles are flexible/situational (degree of application varies)
Principles provide guidelines, not readymade solutions

questions.solution:
The two points highlighting the nature of principles of management in the above case are:

First, Management principles have universal applicability — Rajiv knows that the same principles of management can be applied to both 'Tako Solutions' (a software company) and 'Sabka Mart Retail' (a supermarket chain). This reflects that management principles are universal, meaning they can be applied in all types of organisations — business or non-business, small or large, manufacturing or service — regardless of their nature. This universality makes management principles widely applicable across diverse contexts.

Second, Management principles are flexible and contingent — although the principles apply to both companies, Rajiv acknowledges that the extent of their application will differ because the nature of work, scale of operations and business activities of a software firm and a supermarket chain are not identical. This reflects that management principles are not rigid but flexible — they must be adapted and applied with judgment according to the specific situation, size, type and needs of each organisation.

questions.text: 'जी डब्ल्यू इंडस्ट्रीज', जो अपने कागज़ के उत्पादों के लिए जानी जाती है, ने 'ईको पैक' नाम से एक नए प्रकार की टिकाऊ पैकेजिंग उत्पादित और शुरू करने का निर्णय लिया। चूँकि प्रबन्ध एक जटिल क्रिया है, अतः कम्पनी के मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी ने कार्य को स्पष्ट लक्ष्यों में परिवर्तित किया और उन्हें प्राप्त करने के साधन निर्धारित किए। वह जानता था कि मानव संसाधन किसी संगठन की सबसे बड़ी सम्पत्ति होते हैं, अतः उनसे कार्य करा लेना भी एक बड़ा कार्य होता है। उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली टिकाऊ पैकेजिंग के उत्पादन के लिए एक सुव्यवस्थित उत्पादन प्रक्रिया भी आवश्यक थी। इसे आगत माल और तकनीक के प्रवाह को प्रबंधित करने के लिए लागू किया गया ताकि इन सामग्रियों को उच्च गुणवत्ता वाली टिकाऊ पैकेजिंग में परिवर्तित किया जा सके। इस प्रकार 'जी डब्ल्यू इंडस्ट्रीज' ने 'ईको पैक' की सफल शुरुआत के लिए विभिन्न पहलुओं को ध्यान में रखा। उपरोक्त स्थिति में प्रबन्ध की एक विशेषता की चर्चा की गई है। विशेषता को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english: 'GW Industries', known for its paper products, decided to produce and launch a new line of sustainable packaging called 'EcoPac'. As management is a complex activity, the Chief Executive Officer of the company translated the work into clear goals and assigned the means to achieve those. He knew that human resources are the greatest asset of an organization, so getting work done through them is also a major task. The production of high quality sustainable packaging also required a proper production process. This was put in place for managing the flow of input materials and technology to convert these materials into high quality sustainable packaging. In this way 'GW industries' took care of various aspects for successful launch of 'EcoPac'. A characteristic of management is discussed in the above case. Identify and explain the characteristic.

key_points: Involves multiple dimensions: goal-setting, human resource management, production process management
Management coordinates diverse activities and resources

questions.solution:
The characteristic of management highlighted in the above case is that Management is a complex activity.

Management is complex because it involves performing multiple diverse tasks and handling several dimensions simultaneously. The case illustrates this complexity in three ways. First, the CEO had to set clear goals and determine the means to achieve them — this is planning and goal-setting. Second, the CEO recognised that human resources are the greatest asset and that getting work done through people requires skill, motivation and leadership — this reflects the human dimension of management. Third, a well-organised production process had to be established to manage the flow of inputs and technology — this reflects the operational and technical dimension. Together, these diverse and simultaneous activities of coordinating people, processes, materials and goals demonstrate that management is indeed a complex, multi-dimensional activity requiring knowledge, judgment and skill.

questions.text: 'ईको केयर', एक स्टार्टअप है जो पर्यावरण के प्रति जागरूक सहस्राब्दियों तथा जेन ज़ी (जिनका डिजिटल युग में पालन पोषण हुआ) के लिए एक पुनः प्रयोग में लाई जाने वाली पानी की बोतल का शुभारंभ करने की योजना बना रही है। इसके लिए उन्होंने बाज़ार सर्वेक्षण किया ताकि उपभोक्ताओं की आवश्यकताओं को पहचाना जा सके तथा उत्पाद के सफल विपणन के लिए जानकारी पर आधारित निर्णय लिया जा सके। वे डिज़ाइन पर भी बहुत ध्यानपूर्वक कार्य करना चाहते थे ताकि लक्षित उपभोक्ताओं के लिए बोतल को आकर्षक बनाया जा सके। उपभोक्ताओं के विचारों एवं राय के आधार पर उन्होंने दोहरी दीवार के इन्सुलेशन के साथ एक स्टाइलिश बोतल विकसित की जिसमें पेय पदार्थों को 24 घंटे तक ठंडा रखा जा सकता है तथा बाज़ार में इसे और अधिक प्रतियोगी बना सकता है। उन्होंने बोतल का नाम 'ईको-सिप' रखा जिससे स्थिरता और सरलता पर केन्द्रित एक ब्राण्ड पहचान बनी। इससे उत्पाद विभेदीकरण में भी सहायता मिलेगी। पैकेजिंग को सौ प्रतिशत पुनःचक्रीय कार्डबोर्ड (गत्ता) का उपयोग करके बनाया गया जिस पर टिकाऊपन, विशेषताएँ, मूल्य इत्यादि विवरण छपे हुए थे। उपरोक्त स्थिति में 'ईको केयर' द्वारा पूरे किए गए विपणन के चार कार्यों का उल्लेख कीजिए।
questions.text_english: 'Eco Care', a start-up, plans to launch a reusable water bottle for environmentally conscious millennials and Gen Z. For this, they conducted a market research to identify the needs of the customers so that an informed decision could be taken for successful marketing of the product. They wanted to work carefully on the design to make the bottle attractive to the target customers. On the basis of consumer views and opinions, they developed a stylish stainless steel bottle with double wall insulation to keep beverages cold for 24 hours, giving it a competitive advantage in the market. They named the bottle 'Eco-Sip' creating a brand identity focused on sustainability and simplicity. It would also help in product differentiation. The packaging was made using hundred percent recyclable cardboard, with details of sustainability, features, price etc. printed on it. State the four functions of marketing that are carried out by 'Eco Care' in the above case.
questions.solution:
The four functions of marketing carried out by 'Eco Care' are:

First, Gathering and Analysing Market Information — Eco Care conducted market research to understand the needs of environmentally conscious millennials and Gen Z. This helped them make informed decisions about product development and marketing strategies.

Second, Product Planning and Development — based on consumer feedback, they developed a stylish stainless steel double-wall insulated bottle that keeps beverages cold for 24 hours. This function involves designing a product that satisfies customer needs and has a competitive advantage.

Third, Branding — they named the bottle 'Eco-Sip', creating a distinct brand identity focused on sustainability and simplicity. Branding helps in product differentiation, builds customer loyalty, and makes it easier for consumers to identify the product.

Fourth, Packaging and Labelling — they used 100% recyclable cardboard for packaging with details of sustainability features, price and product information printed on it. Packaging protects the product, attracts customers, and labelling provides necessary information to aid purchase decisions.

questions.text: 'कोका मैन्यूफैक्चरिंग लिमिटेड' इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स उद्योग में एक वृहद् आकार वाली निर्माणी कम्पनी है। इस उद्योग में तकनीक में परिवर्तन के साथ परिसम्पत्तियाँ अप्रचलित हो जाती हैं तथा उनका प्रतिस्थापन शीघ्र ही करना पड़ता है। कम्पनी निरन्तर अपनी मशीनों एवं उपकरणों को उन्नत (अपग्रेड) बनाने के दबाव में रहती है क्योंकि इससे कम्पनी को प्रतिस्पर्धी बने रहने में, उत्पाद की गुणवत्ता के सुधार में तथा उत्पादन लागत को कम करने में सहायता मिलेगी। इसलिए मशीनरी को क्रय करने की अपेक्षा, कम्पनी आवश्यक मशीन को पट्टे पर ले लेने का निर्णय लेती है, जिससे पट्टे की अवधि के अंत में उपकरणों को उन्नत (अपग्रेड) करने का लचीलापन मिलता है। इससे कम्पनी को प्रचालन कुशलता, तकनीकी प्रतिस्पर्धा तथा वित्तीय लचीलापन बनाए रखने में सहायता मिलती है। ऐसे चार घटकों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए जो 'कोका मैन्यूफैक्चरिंग लिमिटेड' की स्थाई पूँजी आवश्यकताओं को प्रभावित करेंगे।
questions.text_english: 'Koka Manufacturing Ltd.' is a large scale manufacturer in the electronics industry. In this industry assets are prone to obsolescence and their replacement becomes due faster with change in technology. The company is constantly under pressure to upgrade its machinery and equipment as it would help company to stay competitive, improve its product quality and reduce production costs. So instead of purchasing the machinery, company decides to lease the required machinery, giving it flexibility to upgrade equipment at the end of lease term. This helps company to maintain operational efficiency, technological competitiveness and financial flexibility. Identify and explain four factors that would affect the fixed capital requirements of 'Koka Manufacturing Ltd.'.

key_points: Nature of business (manufacturing requires heavy fixed assets)
Scale of operations (large scale needs more fixed capital)
Technology used (rapid obsolescence increases replacement need)
Leasing vs buying decision (leasing reduces fixed capital requirement)
Diversification (adding new lines needs new fixed assets)

questions.solution:
Four factors that affect the fixed capital requirements of 'Koka Manufacturing Ltd.' are:

First, Nature of Business — Koka Manufacturing Ltd. is a large-scale manufacturing company in the electronics sector. Manufacturing companies require substantial investment in plant, machinery, equipment and factory buildings as fixed capital. This is unlike trading firms which require less fixed capital. Since Koka is a manufacturing firm, its fixed capital needs are naturally high.

Second, Technology Used — in the electronics industry, technology changes rapidly and assets become obsolete quickly. When a company uses sophisticated and frequently updated technology, its fixed capital needs are higher because machinery must be replaced or upgraded regularly to remain competitive. The pressure to upgrade machines continuously increases fixed capital requirements.

Third, Scale of Operations — Koka is a large-scale manufacturer, which means it requires a large number of machines, tools, buildings and equipment. Larger the scale of operations, greater is the fixed capital requirement because more production facilities are needed to meet higher output targets.

Fourth, Financing Alternative / Leasing Decision — instead of purchasing machinery outright, Koka chooses to lease it. The decision to lease rather than buy significantly reduces the fixed capital requirement because leased assets do not appear as owned assets on the balance sheet. Leasing provides financial flexibility, allows upgrading of assets at the end of the lease term, and reduces the immediate capital outlay needed for fixed assets.

questions.text_english:
(a) Explain the following steps in the staffing process:
(i) Estimating manpower requirements
(ii) Selection
(iii) Placement and orientation
OR
(b) Explain the following non-financial incentives:
(i) Status
(ii) Organisational climate
(iii) Job security

sub_questions.text: मानव-शक्ति आवश्यकताओं का आकलन

key_points: Determining number and type of personnel needed
Based on workload, future plans and current workforce

sub_questions.solution: Estimating manpower requirements is the first step in the staffing process. It involves determining both the number and the type of employees required to carry out the present and future activities of the organisation. Managers must assess how many workers are currently available, how many are likely to retire or leave, and how many new positions will be created due to expansion or diversification. Manpower planning involves both quantitative assessment (how many people) and qualitative assessment (what skills and qualifications are needed). It ensures that the right number of right people are available at the right time to fill the right positions in the organisation.

sub_questions.text: चयन

key_points: Choosing the most suitable candidate from pool of applicants

sub_questions.solution: Selection is the process of choosing the most suitable candidate from the pool of job applicants recruited through internal or external sources. It is a process of elimination — unsuitable candidates are rejected at each stage. The selection process typically includes screening of applications, employment tests (aptitude, psychological, trade tests), interviews, reference and background checks, and a medical examination. The goal is to find the person whose qualifications, skills and personality best match the requirements of the job. A good selection process helps reduce employee turnover, absenteeism and training costs.

sub_questions.text: अनुस्थापन तथा अभिविन्यास

key_points: Placement: assigning the selected person to a specific job
Orientation: familiarising new employee with organisation, colleagues, and work environment

sub_questions.solution: Placement refers to the process of assigning the selected candidate to a specific job or position within the organisation. The employee is placed on the job for which he or she has been selected. Orientation (also called induction) is the process of familiarising the new employee with the organisation — its history, values, culture, policies, procedures, colleagues and the work environment. A well-designed orientation reduces the anxiety and discomfort of the new employee, helps them understand organisational expectations, speeds up their integration into the team and makes them productive more quickly.

sub_questions.text: पद प्रतिष्ठा

key_points: Status refers to rank or position in the organisation
Higher status = more responsibility and recognition

sub_questions.solution: Status as a non-financial incentive refers to the rank, position and social standing that an individual holds within the organisation. Humans have a strong desire for social recognition, respect and prestige. When an organisation assigns a higher designation, a large office, a personal secretary or greater decision-making authority to an employee, it fulfils this psychological need for status. Status motivates employees to perform better and take on greater responsibilities because it provides them with ego satisfaction, recognition and a sense of accomplishment and importance within the organisational hierarchy.

sub_questions.text: संगठनिक वातावरण

key_points: Overall work atmosphere of the organisation

sub_questions.solution: Organisational climate refers to the overall work atmosphere and environment that exists in an organisation — the feelings, attitudes and perceptions of the employees about the nature of their work, management style, communication patterns, teamwork and organisational values. A positive and supportive organisational climate characterised by trust, cooperation, fairness, openness and respect motivates employees to contribute their best. When employees feel valued and that the organisation supports their growth, they are more committed, satisfied and productive. A negative climate, on the other hand, leads to frustration, low morale and high turnover.

sub_questions.text: पद-सुरक्षा

key_points: Reduces anxiety and fear of job loss

sub_questions.solution: Job security is a non-financial incentive that refers to the employee's confidence and assurance that their job will continue for the foreseeable future and that they will not be arbitrarily dismissed or made redundant. The fear of job loss is one of the most de-motivating factors for employees. When an organisation provides assurance of continued employment through stable policies, long-term contracts, or a track record of not laying off workers, employees feel psychologically secure. This security allows them to focus on their work without anxiety, fosters commitment and loyalty, reduces absenteeism and turnover, and improves overall organisational productivity.

key_points: Three staffing steps OR three non-financial incentives explained

questions.solution:
Answer for part (a): (i) Estimating manpower requirements involves assessing the current and future human resource needs of the organisation in terms of number and type of employees needed, based on workload, growth plans and current workforce gaps. (ii) Selection is the process of choosing the most suitable candidate from applicants through tests, interviews and background checks — it is a process of elimination. (iii) Placement is assigning the selected employee to a specific job; Orientation is familiarising them with the organisation, its culture, policies, colleagues and workplace.

Answer for part (b): (i) Status — rank and position in the hierarchy that satisfies employees' social and ego needs, motivating better performance. (ii) Organisational climate — the overall work atmosphere characterised by trust, cooperation and support that encourages employee motivation and commitment. (iii) Job security — assurance of continued employment that reduces anxiety and fosters loyalty and stable performance.

questions.text: रिया बेकरी का एक छोटा-सा ऑनलाइन व्यवसाय चलाती थी। उसका व्यवसाय बहुत अच्छा चल रहा था। वह प्रति माह अच्छी धनराशि की बचत कर रही थी और अब उसे बुद्धिमानी से निवेश करना चाहती थी। वह दुविधा में थी कि अपनी बचत को बैंक खाते में रखे या शेयर बाज़ार में निवेश कर दे। उसकी मित्र आभा ने, जिसने राष्ट्रीय शेयर बाज़ार से एक सर्टिफिकेशन कोर्स किया था, उसे शेयर बाज़ार में निवेश करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित किया। उसने रिया को समझाया कि यदि वह शेयर बाज़ार में निवेश करेगी तो जब भी वह चाहेगी, उसे विनिवेश एवं पुनर्निवेश कर सकेगी, जिससे उसे अच्छी द्रवता मिलेगी। आभा ने यह भी बताया कि शेयर बाज़ार की सदस्यता बेहतर ढंग से विनियमित होती है और सभी लेन-देन कानूनी ढाँचे के अनुसार किए जाते हैं। परिणामस्वरूप निवेशकों को उचित एवं सुरक्षित लेन-देन मिलते हैं। रिया अब भी आशंकित थी क्योंकि उसने सुना था कि शेयर बाज़ार में अत्यधिक सट्टा होता है। वह सतर्क रहना चाहती थी। आभा ने स्पष्टीकरण दिया कि सट्टेबाज़ी विद्यमान होती है लेकिन यह प्रतिबंधित एवं नियंत्रित तरीके से की जाती है। उसने रिया को यह भी बताया कि शेयर बाज़ार व्यापक स्वामित्व को बढ़ावा देने में इच्छुक रहता है और यह लोगों को निवेश के बारे में शिक्षित करके ऐसा करता है। परिणामस्वरूप युवाओं ने शेयर बाज़ार में निवेश करना आरम्भ कर दिया है। इस चर्चा के बाद रिया को आत्मविश्वास हुआ और उसने अपनी बचत के एक भाग को शेयर बाज़ार में निवेश करने का निर्णय लिया। पंक्तियों को उद्धृत करते हुए शेयर बाज़ार के उन चार कार्यों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए जिन पर उपरोक्त स्थिति में प्रकाश डाला गया है।
questions.text_english: Ria ran a small online bakery business. Her business was doing very well. She saved a good amount of money every month and now wanted to invest it wisely. She was in a dilemma to keep her savings in a bank account or to invest it in the stock market. Her friend Aabha, who had done a certification course from National Stock Exchange, encouraged her to invest in the stock market. She explained to Ria that if she invests in the stock market, she could disinvest and reinvest whenever she wanted, which would provide her good liquidity. Aabha also told her that the membership of stock exchange is well regulated and all trading takes place within the legal framework. As a result, investors get a fair and safe deal. Ria was still apprehensive as she had heard that there is lot of speculation in the stock market. She wanted to be cautious. Aabha clarified that speculation does exist, but it happens in a restricted and controlled way. She also told Ria that the stock exchange is keen to promote wider share ownership and does so by educating public about investments etc. As a result, young people have started investing in the stock market. After all this discussion, Ria felt confident and decided to invest a part of her savings in the stock market. Quoting lines, identify and explain the four functions of stock exchange highlighted in the above case.

key_points: Spreading equity cult / promoting wider share ownership

questions.solution:
The four functions of the stock exchange highlighted in the case, with relevant lines, are:

First, Providing Liquidity and Marketability to Existing Securities — the line 'she could disinvest and reinvest whenever she wanted, which would provide her good liquidity' highlights this function. The stock exchange provides a ready market where investors can buy and sell securities at any time. This ensures that securities are liquid — investors can convert them into cash without undue delay, making them an attractive investment.

Second, Safety of Transactions — the line 'membership of stock exchange is well regulated and all trading takes place within the legal framework, as a result investors get a fair and safe deal' highlights this function. The stock exchange ensures safety by regulating its members, enforcing rules and ensuring all transactions happen within the established legal and regulatory framework, protecting investors from fraud and manipulation.

Third, Controlling Speculation — the line 'speculation does exist, but it happens in a restricted and controlled way' highlights this function. While some level of speculation adds liquidity to the market, excessive speculation can cause instability. Stock exchanges regulate and control speculative activities to prevent excessive volatility and protect genuine investors from harmful price distortions.

Fourth, Spreading the Equity Cult / Promoting Wider Share Ownership — the line 'stock exchange is keen to promote wider share ownership and does so by educating the public about investments and as a result young people have started investing' highlights this function. Stock exchanges actively promote investment awareness and financial literacy among the general public, broadening the investor base and encouraging more people to participate in the capital market.
